question.problem:
Let $X$ and $Y$ be two continuous random variables with the following conditional probability density function:

$$
{f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y)=\{\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡x, & \,0\le x\le \frac{\pi }{2} \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Find $P(X<Y\,|\,Y=\frac{\pi }{3}).$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that 

$$
P(X\in A\,|\,Y=y)={\int }_{A}{f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y)\,\text{d}x,
$$

where ${f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y)$ is the conditional probability density function of $X$ given $Y=y.$ 

In our case, we have 

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X<Y\,|\,Y=\frac{\pi }{3}) & =P(X<\frac{\pi }{3}\,|\,Y=\frac{\pi }{3}) \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\pi /3}{f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y=\frac{\pi }{3})\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\pi /3}\operatorname{sin}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =[-\operatorname{cos}⁡x]_{0}^{\pi /3} \\  & =(-\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3})+\operatorname{cos}⁡0) \\  & =-\frac{1}{2}+1 \\  & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
